title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: use-after-free in coap_oscore_auth_mutating -> auth.payload points to stack
description:
CRITICAL bug: coap_oscore_auth_mutating() stores a pointer to its stack-allocated 'plain' buffer in result->payload. All callers (deaddrop_post, msg_inbox_post) then dereference this pointer after coap_oscore_auth_mutating has returned, when the stack frame no longer exists.

Location: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:249 — uint8_t plain[CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_PLAINTEXT_MAX] on stack, result->payload = plain on line ~266. Used at coap_dtn.c:123-124 (parse_recipient, store), coap_server.c:341-345 (null check, msg_post callback).

Fix options: (a) have the caller pass a pre-allocated buffer, (b) use a static buffer, (c) use inversion-of-control (callback pattern).
